name: 01-workflows
caption: The junior engineer opens Workflows: everything the platform can run. New workflow starts one.

name: 02-new-blank
caption: New workflow, Blank: a title, the name the file and the URL use, a noun and a verb that name its endpoint, and the owner team.

name: 03-canvas
caption: The designer opens on the n8n-style canvas: the API trigger every workflow has, and a button for the first step.

name: 04-inputs
caption: Settings, Input: the fields the person running it fills in. They become the run form, the API body and the MCP tool’s arguments.

name: 05-node-creator
caption: Add first step opens the step list. HTTP request calls any API: no provider is needed.

name: 06-http-step
caption: The step’s parameters: POST to the VM API, with the JSON body mapped from the input with {{ }} expressions. The input’s fields on the left can be dragged onto a parameter.

name: 07-credential-field
caption: The step’s credential field lists the credentials already stored, by name and kind. None is for the VM API yet; the list ends with New credential.

name: 08-credential-dialog
caption: New credential opens over the canvas: a token for the VM API, stored once under a name. Nobody can read the value back.

name: 09-credential-set
caption: The field now names the credential: the step keeps only the reference vault:acme-cloud/api-token, and the token goes as a bearer header on each call.

name: 10-get-step
caption: A second HTTP step reads the VM back: GET with the id the create step answered with ($json is the previous step’s output), and the same credential, now picked from the list.

name: 11-outputs
caption: Settings, Outputs: what a finished job answers with, as expressions over the steps: the VM’s id, its address and its state, read back by Get VM.

name: 12-validated
caption: The canvas with both steps. The live checks run as you edit and Validate runs the server’s: no issues.

name: 13-test-run
caption: Test workflow: a dry run with the values a person would type. Nothing is called; each step shows what it would send.

name: 14-yaml
caption: The YAML drawer: the file the designer has been writing all along, the input schema and then the steps. It is what the change request will hold.

name: 15-publish
caption: Publish opens a change request with the workflow’s checks, right in the designer. The author waits for a teammate to merge it.

name: 16-cr-review
caption: A reviewer opens the change request: the workflow file, what changed and the checks. Then Merge.

name: 17-merged
caption: Merged: version 0.1.0 of Create VM is published, with its endpoint, its MCP tool and a run form in the catalog.

name: 18-run-form
caption: The run form, generated from the input defined in the designer. The junior engineer asks for web-07.

name: 19-job
caption: The job: both steps succeeded. Create VM called the VM API and Get VM read the VM back; the output is its id, address and state.

name: 20-executions
caption: Back in the designer, Executions shows the job on the canvas: each step green, and its input and output a click away.
